event.name: Gran Canaria World Cup
event.cover_sub: My top 4 women to make the final in Pozo Izquierdo. Powerful side-shore winds, big jumps and world-class wave riding at one of the most iconic venues on tour.

picks.name: Lina Erpenstein
picks.why: Missed Pozo last year through injury, but she'll be hungry to get {{back into the top 4}}.

picks.name: Sol Degrieck
picks.why: One of the youngest in the fleet was on full send mode in Pozo last year with some amazing wave rides, and we're backing her to {{go one better}} here.

picks.name: Sarah-Quita Offringa
picks.why: We don't need a reason to include Sarah-Quita in our picks, other than {{it's Sarah-Quita}}.
